intended_object: An accessor that parses the library's own binary input layout for the Bethe epigraph oracle machine. It returns the second component of the top-level pair encoding, which is everything after the dimension word. This is inferred from the docstring and the input-layout comment in the same file.
explanation: The definition is just `machinePairSecond word`: it projects out the payload after the dimension field in the library's own pairing scheme for `List Bool` words. It is one of a chain of field accessors (dimension, rest, precision, tau, and so on) that decode the input format of a Turing-machine-style oracle. It is an implementation detail of that encoding and has no counterpart in standard mathematics.
